maya: AM check-in — quick deal + sec sync
What I did: demoed NovaHealth yesterday, sent KMS/Byok FAQ to legal.
Blockers: legal wants dataflow diagram + HSM keywrap details; customer asking for on‑prem pilot timeline.
Today: gather diagrams, sync with infra for HSM cert ETA, prep SOW draft.

sam: Noted. Created ticket INF-4723 to track HSM cert + attestation. Pinged eng-infra.
PR for demo infra: https://git.internal/redwood/demo-infra/pull/321 — needs review @jordan @lee

jordan: Will review the PR today. For the SSO/SCIM ask, draft docs are here: https://confluence.internal/redwood/sso-scim — will pull relevant sections.
Also need production perf numbers for Dedicated (95th/p99) to include in SOW.

lee: Quick numbers: 95th ~120ms for 128-token runs on Dedicated A100; p99 ~240ms (depends on batching). I'll attach bench results after lunch.
I can also redact vendor-sensitive bits for presales docs.

olivia: Customer also requested SOC2 evidence + KMS attestation details. Maya, can we share our attestation report or do we need to redact?

maya: I think redacted attestation is fine; legal to confirm. @lee can infra provide a non-sensitive keywrap snippet we can share for presales (no keys, just flow diagram/code sample)?

compliance-bot: Internal reference — KMS attestation & sharing guidelines: https://vault.internal/compliance/kms-attestations. See section "Sharing with prospects" (redaction checklist).

sam: Blocker for outreach: need SRE to confirm Dedicated pool capacity for demo week (May 8-12). Can eng-sre confirm headroom for a pilot at 50 qps steady, bursts to 200 qps?

lee: Pinged #eng-sre. Also vendor asked for a technical contact for HSM integration — I'll add contact to vendor thread and share vendor name in the ticket.

jordan: On commercial side, we need a rough SOW by EOD Fri. Olivia, can you draft a baseline SOW using committed qps and projected token counts?

olivia: Yep — will draft. Maya, can you send expected qps + average sequence length for the pilot so I can size it?

maya: Expected numbers: 50 qps steady, avg seq 128 tokens, burst to 200 qps for short windows. I'll DM the test prompt set and attach a short request/response sample.

sam: Quick ops asks: code review ping to @jordan on PR, and @lee for bench artifacts. If no response, I'll escalate in #eng-oncall.

lee: Will post bench artifacts and the redacted diagram by 16:00 PT. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — one more small ask: can someone run a smoke test of the private-deploy Helm chart? Left a note in the ops-runbook (section "private-deploy smoke").

jordan: I can run the smoke after the PR review. ETA ~2h.

sam: I'll follow up in #eng-sre in 30m if we don't have capacity confirmation.

maya: Great — that's it from me. If legal confirms redaction approach, I'll update the customer and loop Olivia for SOW numbers.

--- end thread ---
